committed.order: viewport-sized 390x844 and 1440x900 shots, then the full-page 390x844 shots, then 360x640, then 430x932 and 844x390; the kept set is a prefix of this order
committed.fullPageScale: full-page shots are scaled to 780 px wide (2x); viewport shots keep their size (390x844 and 360x640 at 3x, 1440x900 at 1x)
